name: Nielsen Norman Group (NN/g) 4 Dimensions of Tone of Voice
diagnostic: Where does our content fall along the four universal tonal axes across different user states and contexts?
artifact: Four bipolar axes — Funny↔Serious, Formal↔Casual, Respectful↔Irreverent, Matter-of-Fact↔Enthusiastic — each with copy treatments across onboarding, core tasks and system errors.
trap: Staying playful through critical failures — a failed transaction, a locked account — alienates users already under stress.
pedigreeFull: Nielsen Norman Group (Kate Moran, 2016). A digital user experience research framework that isolates verbal identity into four bipolar, actionable dimensions.
artifactFull: A 4-Axis Bipolar Tone Matrix: Funny ↔ Serious; Formal ↔ Casual; Respectful ↔ Irreverent; Matter-of-Fact ↔ Enthusiastic, supported by practical copy treatments across onboarding, core tasks, and system errors.
trapFull: Adopting an irreverent or playful tone during critical product failures (e.g., failed transactions, authentication locks), which alienates users under stress.
